children.name: Article Title
children.text: Platform settings, telemetry, and build info

children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Maintain instance identity and defaults, review the telemetry tiers and opt-out, and capture exact build data for support.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: External URL changes affect OIDC redirects, links, and integrations; update dependent systems before saving it.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Keep instance name, canonical external URL, and default namespace stable and environment-specific.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use a name that distinguishes environments and clusters (optional)

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Coordinate redirect URLs before changing the canonical external URL.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Verify RBAC, quota, storage, and network policy in the default namespace.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: On by default for new installs; reports go to the project's provider unless an operator disables or redirects them.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Basic sends version and two counts; extended adds coarse environment and usage bands.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Set api.telemetry.enabled=false for a hard off; a custom api.telemetry.endpoint replaces the default destination.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Basic-saved installs with no destination start sending after v0.4.0; set api.telemetry.enabled=false before upgrading.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Update channel comes from Helm; record build hash, Kubernetes version, and license before troubleshooting or upgrading.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Stable instance name + canonical URL + intentional namespace

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Telemetry tiers chosen on purpose (or disabled at install); monitoring stays separate

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Record chart/build/Kubernetes/values before support or upgrade
